CustomField.description: Only used when Strategy__c is SubstituteFromList. Comma-separated list of realistic dummy values to substitute in place of the real one, e.g. a list of fake first names.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Comma-separated dummy values to pick from at random, e.g. "Alex,Jordan,Sam,Taylor". Only applies when Strategy is Substitute From List.
CustomField.label: Substitute Values
